Definition: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dig, cleave, divide, hew, make, cut out, dig out, cut down, quarry, hewer, mason; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to hew out, dig; 1a2) to hew; 1a2a) stone; 1a2b) wood; 1a3) to hew in pieces (metaph.); 1a4) to divide, cleave; 1b) (Niphal) to be cut, be hewn, be engraved; 1c) (Hiphil) to hew into pieces, cut up into pieces; 1d) (Pual) to be cut from, be hewn from
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
